facts.fact: The World Heritage series contains nine religious and civic structures associated with Norman Sicily,1130–1194.
facts.excerpt: a series of nine religious and civic structures dating from the era of the Norman kingdom of Sicily (1130-1194)

facts.fact: The designated series includes the Royal Palace and Palatine Chapel and Palermo Cathedral; the whole five-stop walk is not a single UNESCO designation.
facts.excerpt: the Royal Palace and Palatine Chapel; Zisa Palace; Palermo Cathedral; Monreale Cathedral; Cefalù Cathedral

facts.fact: The architecture reflects exchange among Western, Islamic and Byzantine cultures.
facts.excerpt: a socio-cultural syncretism between Western, Islamic, and Byzantine cultures

title: UNESCO — Arab-Norman Palermo, Cefalù and Monreale
